featured_reviews.review_text: Editing the review after my wedding. Had the worst experience ever! The make up team reached late at the venue. featured_reviews.review_text:

I trusted the reviews before booking, but my experience was completely different.
Would not recommend this studio. Giving 1 star only because 0 is not an option.
